name: Skills that ship with their evals
status: release-candidate-1 (draft, not for sale; no price, no checkout)
free_core: free-skills/<skill>/ stays MIT and unchanged by this pack
pro_pack: update channel: re-run on model or skill change
eval_runner: claude plugin eval (Claude Code 2.1.310) via scripts/eval-skill.mjs, no-plugin baseline arm

jobs.ui-ux-design-expert: Reviews a page's markup and CSS for WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility defects and names the element and the fix.
jobs.github-code-review: Reviews a pull-request diff for merge-blocking correctness and security bugs, line by line.
jobs.nextjs-expert: Reviews and builds Next.js 16 App Router code, including the version-specific changes that compile fine and break in production.
jobs.mcp-architecture: Designs and reviews MCP servers: tool and resource boundaries, input schemas, annotations, auth and secret handling.
jobs.ai-architect-review: Reviews the architecture of an LLM-calling system before launch: model seam, loop bounds, trust boundaries, durability, cost and evals.
jobs.langgraph-patterns: Builds and debugs LangGraph agents: state reducers, routing, tool binding, checkpointing and human-in-the-loop interrupts.
jobs.skill-builder: Writes and reviews Agent Skills (SKILL.md) so they load, trigger at the right time and stay safe to share.
jobs.product-management-expert: Reviews PRDs and product plans for missing evidence, unmeasurable metrics, scope contradictions and risky rollouts.
jobs.book-publishing: Edits nonfiction book chapters against a house voice and production rules.
jobs.excellence-book-writing: Revises long-form nonfiction prose for structure, clarity and voice, removing AI-sounding patterns.
